project.title: Yash Tools Android — Google Play v1
project.description: Delivery system for the first Google Play release containing all 87 audited tools.
project.readme: Tracks foundation, all 87 tool migrations, quality/device certification, closed testing, signing, store preparation, and the explicitly authorized first production launch. Issues and pull requests provide evidence; project fields provide planning views. Production publication still requires explicit product-owner authorization.

milestones.title: Foundation Complete
milestones.description: Platform contracts, recovery, native bridges, instrumentation, and foundation physical-device evidence pass.

milestones.title: 12-Tool Architecture Milestone
milestones.description: All 12 representative tools pass their Definition of Done on bundled Android artifacts.

milestones.title: Tier 1 Directly Portable Catalog
milestones.description: All remaining directly portable catalog tools pass their Definition of Done.

milestones.title: Adapter and Policy-Heavy Catalog
milestones.description: Tier 2–4 file, storage, timer, network, media, permission, and special-review tools pass.

milestones.title: All-87 Closed Beta
milestones.description: One candidate with all 87 tools enabled passes closed testing and complete quality evidence.

milestones.title: Google Play v1 Launch
milestones.description: Signing, store, policy, production eligibility, pre-launch, launch plan, and explicit publication authorization pass.

epics.title: [Epic] Launch Yash Tools v1 on Google Play with all 87 tools
epics.outcome: Publish the reviewed, signed, all-87-tool Android application through the explicitly approved first managed-publishing launch window.
acceptance: All 87 audited tools are enabled and pass the repository Definition of Done.
Architecture, closed-beta, and production gates all pass against the same candidate.
The product owner explicitly authorizes publication after reviewing the final AAB hash and launch record.

epics.title: [Epic] Complete foundation and native platform
epics.outcome: Finish the shared Android platform, recovery, file, clipboard, lifecycle, instrumentation, and device foundations required by the catalog.
acceptance: Every foundation sub-issue is complete with tests and artifact evidence.
No unresolved permission, export, privacy, storage, or recovery architecture gap remains.

epics.title: [Epic] Deliver all 7 Core tools
epics.outcome: Deliver all seven audited Core tools at production quality.
acceptance: All 7 Core tool sub-issues are complete.
The release manifest and store claims include the same reviewed Core catalog.

epics.title: [Epic] Deliver all 45 Developer tools
epics.outcome: Deliver all 45 audited Developer tools, including network and special-policy entries, at production quality.
acceptance: All 45 Developer tool sub-issues are complete.
YouTube Downloader has explicit compliant policy/legal/provider evidence or the all-87 scope is formally revisited.

epics.title: [Epic] Deliver all 17 Text tools
epics.outcome: Deliver all 17 audited Text tools, including durable Notes and timer behavior, at production quality.
acceptance: All 17 Text tool sub-issues are complete.
Durable data, export, lifecycle, notification, and recovery behavior pass.

epics.title: [Epic] Deliver all 3 Media tools
epics.outcome: Deliver Audio Recorder, Video to GIF, and File Hash Checker with reviewed permissions, memory limits, streaming, and device evidence.
acceptance: All 3 Media tool sub-issues are complete.
Microphone, encoding, large-file, privacy, and Play-policy evidence passes.

epics.title: [Epic] Deliver all 5 Security tools
epics.outcome: Deliver all five audited Security tools without logging or persisting sensitive inputs.
acceptance: All 5 Security tool sub-issues are complete.
Security wording, correctness oracles, clipboard handling, and sensitive-data tests pass.

epics.title: [Epic] Deliver all 10 Math tools
epics.outcome: Deliver all ten audited Math tools with independent correctness, time, locale, accessibility, and lifecycle evidence.
acceptance: All 10 Math tool sub-issues are complete.
Calculations, time tools, simulations, and accessibility output pass independent fixtures.

epics.title: [Epic] Certify quality, accessibility, performance, and Android devices
epics.outcome: Produce complete cross-catalog automated, accessibility, performance, interoperability, and physical-device evidence for the all-87 candidate.
acceptance: Every quality sub-issue passes against identified artifacts.
No critical/high security issue, data-loss defect, or release-threshold regression remains.

epics.title: [Epic] Prepare and execute the first Google Play launch
epics.outcome: Complete identity, signing, policy declarations, store assets, closed testing, pre-launch triage, candidate approval, and managed publication.
acceptance: Every release sub-issue passes against one reproducible signed candidate.
Publication occurs only after explicit product-owner authorization.

tasks.title: Establish GitHub launch work-management system
tasks.outcome: Provide the durable issue hierarchy, dependencies, milestones, labels, project fields, templates, and repository automation used through the first Google Play launch.
acceptance: All 87 audited tools and every launch gate are represented by stable, idempotently provisioned work items.
The project workflow, issue hierarchy, dependencies, templates, and contributor rules are documented and independently reproducible from the repository.

tasks.title: Land scoped Android document picker and Save As bridge
tasks.outcome: Review and merge the verified SAF/Save As implementation without broad storage permissions.
acceptance: PR #1 passes review and required CI.
System-picker and process-recreation device evidence is linked before the foundation gate closes.

tasks.title: Enforce protected main branch and immutable CI supply chain
tasks.outcome: Require pull requests and passing web-quality/android-debug checks on main, prohibit force pushes and deletion, and pin every CI action to an audited immutable commit.
acceptance: Every third-party action reference is pinned to a reviewed full commit SHA with its release line documented.
The private repository plan supports branch protection or rulesets and main requires pull requests, both CI jobs, resolved conversations, linear history, and no force push or deletion.

tasks.title: Implement sensitive Android clipboard metadata
tasks.outcome: Provide a narrow platform-contract path that marks secrets as sensitive on supported Android versions without logging values.
acceptance: Normal and sensitive copy semantics have adapter/native tests.
Clipboard values never enter logs and newer clipboard contents are never cleared by stale timers.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic generated-file cache cleanup and retention
tasks.outcome: Bound cache lifetime and clean abandoned generated share and Save As handoffs without deleting active or unrelated data.
acceptance: Retention, startup/lifecycle cleanup, concurrency, low-space, cancellation, process death, and receiver/provider-lazy-read behavior have tests.
Both `cache/share/` files and `cache/save/<operation>/` handoffs have bounded retention, including orphan recovery after process death or failed immediate cleanup.
Active operations are protected and only validated operation-owned cache paths are eligible for deletion; unrelated cache and user data remain untouched.

tasks.title: Implement WebView renderer termination recovery and native safe mode
tasks.outcome: Recover from renderer termination and repeated startup failure without loops or restoration of sensitive input.
acceptance: Native safe mode offers reload and catalog recovery from a renderer-independent surface.
Crash-loop thresholds, nonsensitive state restoration, diagnostics, and process recreation are tested.

tasks.title: Add Android instrumentation and UI Automator foundation coverage
tasks.outcome: Automate process recreation, permission denial, picker, Save As, sharing, notifications, Back, and recovery behavior.
acceptance: Tests run against bundled Android artifacts without a development server.
Permission/export budgets are not weakened to make automation pass.

tasks.title: Execute the physical-device foundation checklist
tasks.outcome: Install the current artifact and record navigation, rotation, process, theme, clipboard, files, sharing, notifications, offline, recovery, and enabled-tool results.
acceptance: Device model, Android/API, WebView, navigation mode, artifact hash, and privacy-safe evidence are recorded.
Every failed or blocked checklist row links a follow-up issue.

tasks.title: Add bounded or streamed content-URI reads
tasks.outcome: Allow reviewed file-consuming tools to process user-selected content URIs with strict limits and cancellation.
acceptance: The bridge accepts no arbitrary paths or intents and adds no broad storage/media permission.
Unknown sizes, provider failures, cancellation, low memory, cleanup, and process interruption are tested.

tasks.title: Close the architecture-proven foundation gate
tasks.outcome: Reconcile source, tests, manifests, adapters, ADRs, artifacts, and device evidence before scaling migration.
acceptance: No critical architecture decision or foundation blocker remains.
The tracker contains current evidence, artifact hashes, risks, blockers, and the next queue.

tasks.title: Complete the all-87 automated regression matrix
tasks.outcome: Run pure, component, adapter, E2E, Android, manifest, and artifact tests across all enabled tools.
acceptance: Every tool maps to independent fixtures and applicable test layers.
The matrix records artifact commit/hash and contains no weakened or skipped release gates.

tasks.title: Certify accessibility and adaptive layouts for all 87 tools
tasks.outcome: Verify TalkBack, Switch Access, keyboard, 200% text, contrast, reduced motion, touch targets, phones, tablets, landscape, and split-screen.
acceptance: Every enabled screen has evidence or a documented release-blocking defect.
Canvas/editor output has accessible equivalents and no essential information relies on color, motion, or hover.

tasks.title: Certify startup, memory, responsiveness, cancellation, and size budgets
tasks.outcome: Profile the full catalog and high-memory tools on the approved device matrix and release build.
acceptance: Cold start, chunk, memory, input/output, long-task, cancellation, and 16 KB compatibility budgets pass or have approved ADR exceptions.
No tool blocks the UI or permits unbounded allocation.

tasks.title: Complete security, privacy, dependency, license, notices, and SBOM audit
tasks.outcome: Reconcile the threat model, permission/export budget, data inventory, providers, dependencies, licenses, provenance, notices, and SBOM against the candidate.
acceptance: No critical/high security issue or known data-loss defect remains.
Privacy, Data Safety, provider, permission, license, provenance, and store claims match the exact artifact.

tasks.title: Execute the final Android device and WebView compatibility matrix
tasks.outcome: Verify the all-87 candidate across approved Android versions, OEM behavior, WebView versions, form factors, navigation modes, and low-resource conditions.
acceptance: The complete matrix records models, API/WebView, artifact hashes, results, and follow-up disposition.
Process, renderer, storage, sharing, notification, offline, accessibility, and every enabled tool are covered.

tasks.title: Certify import, export, Save As, and sharing interoperability
tasks.outcome: Verify canonical MIME, extension, encoding, filenames, finalized bytes, grants, lazy receivers, cancellation, and cleanup for every file format.
acceptance: Each exported format works with at least two intended receiving apps where applicable.
Preview, Share, and Save use identical finalized bytes and no private path is exposed.

tasks.title: Approve final app identity, package, origin, audience, countries, and pricing
tasks.outcome: Replace or explicitly approve every provisional identity and market decision before Play app creation.
acceptance: Name, immutable application ID, bundled origin, publisher/account type, audience, countries, language, category, free/no-ads posture, and domain are approved in ADRs.
All source, Android resources, support/privacy URLs, and Play metadata agree.

tasks.title: Create and validate final launcher icons and splash screen
tasks.outcome: Replace generated placeholders with approved adaptive, monochrome, round, legacy, and splash assets.
acceptance: Assets render correctly across supported launchers, themes, masks, API levels, and Play listing requirements.
Asset provenance and visual approval are recorded.

tasks.title: Verify Play developer account and register the final package
tasks.outcome: Complete personal/organization verification, package registration, public contact, trader/legal, and production-access prerequisites without sharing credentials.
acceptance: Account and package state is recorded without passwords, recovery codes, keys, or service-account files.
Applicable closed-testing eligibility and regional publisher obligations are known.

tasks.title: Approve production signing, Play App Signing, upload-key custody, and recovery
tasks.outcome: Establish auditable signing ownership and recovery outside the repository and untrusted CI.
acceptance: Play App Signing enrollment, upload key, separate backups, named owners, rotation/recovery, CI secret boundaries, and clean-build reproduction are approved and rehearsed.
No secret material appears in Git, issues, logs, fixtures, or pull-request CI.

tasks.title: Publish privacy policy and complete Play declarations
tasks.outcome: Make privacy, Data Safety, permissions, target audience, content rating, ads, app access, Financial Features, export, and provider declarations match the candidate.
acceptance: Public privacy/support/security URLs are live and match bundled offline summaries.
Every SDK, network tool, durable data path, permission, export format, and deletion/retention behavior is reconciled.

tasks.title: Prepare the final Google Play listing, screenshots, and support content
tasks.outcome: Produce honest listing text and real phone/tablet screenshots for the exact all-87 release candidate.
acceptance: Title, short/full descriptions, category, feature graphic, icon, screenshots, contact links, help, limitations, network disclosures, and 87-tool claims match the artifact.
No fabricated review, rating, capability, privacy, reliability, or offline claim is used.

tasks.title: Approve production network providers, CORS behavior, terms, caching, and fallback
tasks.outcome: Prove packaged-origin behavior and approve provider terms, domains, attribution, rates, country availability, privacy, timeouts, cache, offline, removal, and fallback behavior.
acceptance: Only reviewed HTTPS origins are allowlisted and cold/offline/stale/error states pass.
Privacy and store disclosures match actual provider requests and retained cache data.

tasks.title: Complete Audio Recorder permission, privacy, format, and device review
tasks.outcome: Approve a foreground-only, user-initiated recording design with narrow permission and honest format/privacy behavior.
acceptance: Permission denial/revocation, interruptions, calls/routes, backgrounding, duration/size, low storage, export, cleanup, and privacy declarations pass.
No background microphone permission or misleading recording claim is introduced.

tasks.title: Complete Video to GIF worker, codec, memory, metadata, and device review
tasks.outcome: Approve a bounded cancellable encoding path that does not block the renderer or exhaust memory.
acceptance: Duration, dimensions, frames, bytes, metadata, cancellation, unsupported codec, interruption, low memory/storage, output, and device limits pass.
Codec/dependency licenses and 16 KB/native-library implications are approved.

tasks.title: Complete YouTube Downloader Play-policy, legal, provider, reliability, and product review
tasks.outcome: Determine and evidence whether the audited downloader can be legally, contractually, reliably, and policy-compliantly enabled in the all-87 Play release.
acceptance: Play policy, copyright/legal, YouTube and provider terms, data/network behavior, availability, failure/removal behavior, user value, and store wording are reviewed by the appropriate owner.
A failed or unresolved review blocks the all-87 release or triggers an explicit superseding scope ADR; it is never silently shipped or omitted.

tasks.title: Build and approve the reproducible all-87 release candidate
tasks.outcome: Produce one reviewed, signed, reproducible AAB with all 87 tools enabled and every evidence inventory reconciled.
acceptance: Protected commit/tag, version, manifest, tests, device matrix, dependency lock, SBOM, signing, AAB hash, privacy, help, and store claims refer to one candidate.
No release blocker or unreviewed permission/component/dependency/provider remains.

tasks.title: Run required Google Play closed testing and disposition tester findings
tasks.outcome: Meet the account's current closed-testing eligibility requirements with representative use and auditable feedback disposition.
acceptance: Tester enrollment, required continuous period, feedback, regressions, fixes, and production-access application are recorded without collecting unnecessary private data.
All material tester findings are fixed, accepted with evidence, or block production.

tasks.title: Triage Google Play pre-launch, Android vitals, and compatibility findings
tasks.outcome: Review Play automated/device findings and meet internal crash, ANR, security, accessibility, and compatibility thresholds.
acceptance: Every finding has a linked fix, evidence-backed disposition, or release-blocking decision.
The tested Play artifact hash matches the approved candidate.

tasks.title: Rehearse support, incident, rollback, halt, forward-fix, and unpublish runbooks
tasks.outcome: Ensure named owners can respond safely to first-release incidents without assuming rollback repairs installed devices.
acceptance: Support, vulnerability intake, incident severity, halt, forward-fix, unpublish, signing recovery, backup restoration, and communication procedures are rehearsed.
Owners, observation window, stop conditions, and privacy-safe diagnostic paths are recorded.

tasks.title: Approve and execute the first managed-publishing production launch
tasks.outcome: Publish the approved all-87 candidate during a staffed managed-publishing window and record the result.
acceptance: Production access, review approval, countries, managed-publishing state, artifact hash, owners, monitoring, support, observation window, and stop conditions are confirmed.
The product owner explicitly authorizes publication immediately before the irreversible action; this issue does not itself grant publication authority.
